title: The Blue Cart on the Orchard Path
synopsis: Tess and Grandma Fern meet Mira and Grandpa Rowan as they move into the stone cottage with a round window by the orchard path.
continuity_state: Before: After season six, Tess keeps her real yellow map; the original orchard bend, Doorway Tree and fenced mill are established. The Story House garden has leaves but no declared harvest. There is no previously named resident at the stone cottage. After: Mira, a young mouse, and her caregiver Grandpa Rowan move into a small stone cottage on the south orchard path between the Doorway Tree and the fenced old mill, without using the mill. The cottage has a round window. Mira brings a green cushion with one yellow star and Grandpa a small blue handcart. Tess meets them, marks the spot lightly in pencil but does not yet draw the cottage symbol on her map. The important spoon goes on the kitchen table; the cart is unpacked at the doorstep. Mira sleeps at home.

related_resources.reason: ZERO TO THREE describes how familiar objects can offer continuity for some children during transitions; the fictional green cushion illustrates a possible, not universal, experience.
